liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Recommended especially for the Dark Star into Comes a Time stretch; Reviewer finds the Dark Star beautiful [4][5][12]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told//** (1 review): This version has the complete song; the alternate source cut out mid-jam [14]
- **Comes A Time** (1 review): Reviewer describes a profound, psychedelic-aided listening experience beginning at Dark Star and culminating in Comes a Time [10]

## The recordings

- **gd72-07-26.sbd.popi.8957.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 229 min; rated 4.56/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds Jerry's voice smooth and the show mellow, relaxed listening for a morning [13]
- **gd72-07-26.sbd.clugston.1411.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 230 min; rated 4.31/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound clean and good; Vocal mix is too far forward; harmonies bury the instruments, making it hard for this reviewer to listen; Reviewer says the tape speed runs slightly slow, which makes Jerry sound off [5][9][12][14][16]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd-patched.long.34803.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 230 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd.GEMS.87034.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 231 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls the Portland Paramount show while reflecting on digital sharing replacing worn, many-generations-removed cassette copies [7]
- This was the second of two Paramount Theater shows in Portland, Oregon [19]
- Reviewer hesitates to give five stars because many great European and fall tour shows exist [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-07-26.sbd.popi.8957.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan and Popi; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Missing He's Gone from the original md5 set was patched, probably with a re-extraction of the Clugston seed [1]
- **gd72-07-26.sbd.clugston.1411.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Reel [2]. Also: Chain: master soundboard reel to PCM to DAT to ZA2 to two CDR generations; DAT seed via Jeff Tiedrich [2]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd-patched.long.34803.flac16**: transferred by Andrew Long; source: MR > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [4]. Also: Greatest Story was patched from an alternate soundboard source and brightened with iZotope Ozone to match the primary; Primary patch source is shnid 1411; He's Gone was already patched from an alternate source [4]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd.GEMS.87034.flac16**: taped by DAT from Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: MR -> DAT (the DAT is 16-bit; 44.1kHz which could indicate MR->PCM->DAT) [3]
